401490101.text: ...How time flies. My burns are almost healed now, so I should be ready to take back the kitchen tomorrow.

401490102.text: #You've really gone above and beyond these past few days, {NICKNAME}. Last day today — here's hoping we get through it without incident.

401490103.text: Ugh, why does Paimon feel like you just jinxed us again...

401490105.text: Whew, we made it all the way to the evening! It ended up being a pretty smooth day after all. Maybe it's because we've gotten so experienced at running this whole thing?

401490106.text: We've come a long way since our first day on the job, haven't we? Back then, we were struggling to remember who ordered what... But everything's a piece of cake now!

401490109.text: Yeah, but who would come by this late in the evening? Oh... Actually, now that Paimon thinks about it, Lyney and his siblings came around this time on the first day, didn't they...

401490110.text: #{NICKNAME}? Paimon? Fancy seeing you two here!

401490111.text: Amber? And Eula and Mika, too! Are you here for dinner? Why so late in the day?

401490112.text: We just finished an escort mission for a merchant caravan. The original plan was to make do with some rations for this evening and continue our trek north towards Stone Gate...

401490113.text: But Captain Eula brought up the fact that none of us have eaten Liyue cuisine for quite some time. We thought we might as well swing by the inn and see if we can still order something.

401490114.text: Ooh, so this is Eula's treat, huh?

401490115.text: ...Ahem! We've been eating the same rations for the entire trip, so I simply thought it was high time we had ourselves a proper meal. Do you have a problem with that?

401490401.text: Anything goes, huh? Oh dear... This is a chef's worst nightmare. With no idea of your customers' palates, you're left to make a wild guess...

401490402.text: Still, now that you've worked in the kitchen for so many days, I have faith that you'll be able to figure it out. Go on, show them what you've got!

401490403.text: (Let me think... What do they like? What could they be craving?)

401490301.text: #There you are, {NICKNAME}! Thank you for all of your hard work over the past few days.

401490302.text: My pleasure... assuming I'm still being paid, that is?

401490303.text: Hahaha, straight down to brass tacks, are we? Here, take it. I've thrown in a little extra as well — call it a bonus. Hard work is rewarded here!

401490304.text: Yay! It's like all the tiredness and stress have suddenly melted away!

401490305.text: I'm just lucky you only worked this job for a few days. At the rate you were progressing, a few more weeks and I think I might be made redundant!

401490306.text: Well, I for one look forward to enjoying your cooking many more times in the future.

401490307.text: Haha, anytime! Bring some friends with you next time, and I'll show you all what Smiley Yanxiao can do when working with both hands intact!

401490308.text: Great! Although... just to be on the safe side, cook carefully in the meantime! You may have just jinxed it again.

subQuests.subQuestName: Bring the food to the waiting Mondstadters

401490201.text: ...Mmm, this is delicious! Perfectly seasoned, and even the rice is bursting with flavor!

401490202.text: Nothing like a piping hot meal served straight from the stove... I've missed this.

401490203.text: #Hehe, you've put the finest Favonian field rations to shame, and that's no mean feat... So tell us, {NICKNAME}, what's this one called?

401490204.text: It's called... um... Paimon's guessing we can't just call it "anything goes," right?

401490205.text: ...Help, Paimon doesn't know how to explain this dish at all! It's got no name, and it's just basic ingredients, simply cooked...

401490206.text: Basic ingredients, simply cooked? Really? I could have sworn that you put something fancy in here, or gave it some kind of chef's magic touch...

401490209.text: Not the finest dish in the world, but the one they need right now...? Okay, you've lost Paimon, what do you mean?

401499201.text: Oil, salt, sauce, vinegar... Right, that's everything we need.

401499301.text: #Why, {NICKNAME}, this year's off to a good start, wouldn't you say?

401499403.text: ...Ah, sorry. I zoned out just now — didn't see you coming.

401499405.text: Yeah... That food you cooked for us just now — it reminded me of the meals my grandfather used to make for me. I thought I'd forgotten how they tasted, but it all came rushing back.

401499406.text: He used to make Liyue dishes all the time. I'd do my Outrider training with him until the evening, and then wait patiently at the dinner table...

401499407.text: ...I'd sit there, with the smell of delicious food wafting in from the kitchen, waiting for him to finally emerge with the goods.

401499408.text: Sometimes we'd have Eula around for dinner, and even though she'd always find something to complain about, I could tell she really enjoyed the food.

401499411.text: ...Your words, not mine. Don't ask her about it — she'll only give you another earful!

401499501.text: Judging from the look on your face, you've already figured it out. Alright then, go ahead and show them what you've got!

401499601.text: I'm sorry! I really can't think of anything off the top of my head... I mean, I could pick from the menu at random, but I'd feel more comfortable leaving the chef to choose.

401499602.text: Oh, one thing — I know I said I don't mind what we have, but no alcohol, please. Neither of them can drink... it's a real pity.

401499603.text: I—I've still got some sparkling water here!

401499701.text: Back when I was on the expedition with the Grand Master, I was often put in charge of cooking.

401499702.text: Under the circumstances, I could only cook some pretty crude meals... But everyone still enjoyed them a lot.

401499703.text: Maybe "passion" was the secret ingredient then, too?

401499801.text: The rations we brought were adapted from my signature Moon Pies. To come up with something even tastier... I gotta hand it to you, you did a great job!

401499802.text: ...Still, please do drop by and try a few Stormcrest Pies next time you're in town. I insist.
